unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in 49 CFR 1540.111(b), when performance of inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Applies when: (1) performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; OR (2) the individual is entering or in a sterile area; OR (3) the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property, if the individual is law enforcement personnel on duty, authorized under listed sections, or authorized in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Applies if the individual is one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; OR (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; OR (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing duty at the airport, an individual authorized to carry a weapon under §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For passengers transporting or offering for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For passengers transporting or offering for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless all specified conditions in (i) through (iv) are met.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All four conditions are required to qualify for the exception: (i) passenger declares orally or in writing before checking baggage that the bag contains an unloaded firearm; AND (ii) the firearm is unloaded; AND (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; AND (iv) the container is locked and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares it orally or in writing before checking baggage, the firearm is unloaded, the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For passengers transporting or offering for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under 49 CFR 1540.111, regarding carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Either in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.statement: 49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Regarding carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
unit_attributes.statement: Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
